newsitem.title: USA: KV Pharmaceutical gets U.S. patents.
newsitem.headline: KV Pharmaceutical gets U.S. patents.

text.p: KV Pharmaceutical said it had been issued two initial U.S. patents for its transesophageal drug delivery system and a bioadhesive gastrointestinal- esophageal protectant.

The company said on Wednesday it had recently received the patents, which cover the concept of using the surface of the esophagus to absorb and deliver certain drugs and other compounds such as bioactive peptides and proteins rather than through other methods such as cheek patches and injections.
A company spokeswoman said the firm believes that patients might prefer the new delivery system, which she called a "new technology and new forum" for administering drugs.
KV Pharmaceutical researches, develops, makes and markets oral drug delivery technology, such as time-released capsules, liquids and syrups.
Its shares closed on Tuesday at 11-1/8.
